info.title: Medicine Wheel events
info.description: The events a Medicine Wheel writes beside its store (events.jsonl) and publishes once a broker is chosen (miadi-chronicle://548). Each message is a MiadiEventEnvelope whose payload names records and carries labels; a consumer reads the record back from the wheel by subject.id. Package: @medicine-wheel/events.

cycleOpened.description: A research cycle was opened. Written by: POST /api/narrative/cycles with a new id; MCP create_research_cycle.

cycleAmended.description: A research cycle changed: its question, its direction, its counts. Written by: POST /api/narrative/cycles with a known id; MCP update_cycle_direction. A cycle's beats list follows from beat.recorded and is not an amendment..

cycleArchived.description: A research cycle was archived for the seven generations. Written by: POST /api/narrative/cycles with `archived: true`; MCP archive_for_seven_generations.

beatRecorded.description: A narrative beat was recorded — in a talking circle, a turn was spoken. Written by: POST /api/narrative/beats with a new id; MCP create_narrative_beat, create_sub_beats.

beatAmended.description: A narrative beat was rewritten. Written by: POST /api/narrative/beats with a known id.

beatWitnessed.description: A beat gained a witness, or its speaker was named. Written by: PATCH /api/narrative/beats/{id}.

ceremonyOpened.description: A ceremony was opened. Written by: POST /api/ceremonies without `closes`; MCP log_ceremony, ceremony lifecycle tools.

ceremonyClosed.description: A ceremony was closed. The subject is the closing record; `closes` names the ceremony it closes. Written by: POST /api/ceremonies with `closes`.

ceremonyAmended.description: A ceremony record was written again under its id. Written by: POST /api/ceremonies with a known id.

ceremonyRemoved.description: A ceremony record nobody entered was removed. Written by: DELETE /api/ceremonies/{id}.

diaryWritten.description: A participant wrote a diary entry. Written by: POST /api/diary with a new id.

diaryAmended.description: A diary entry was written again under its id. Written by: POST /api/diary with a known id.

diaryRemoved.description: A diary entry was removed. Written by: DELETE /api/diary/{id}.

circleCreated.description: A circle was created. Written by: POST /api/nodes with `type: circle`.

circleAmended.description: A circle changed: its name, its description, its metadata. Written by: PATCH /api/nodes/{id}; POST /api/nodes with a known id.

circleRemoved.description: A circle was removed. Written by: DELETE /api/nodes/{id}.

chronicleEpisodeRegistered.description: A chronicle episode was registered on the wheel. Written by: POST /api/nodes with `metadata.kind: chronicle_episode` (mkepisode).

chronicleEpisodeAmended.description: A chronicle episode's card changed. Written by: PATCH /api/nodes/{id}; POST /api/nodes with a known id.

chronicleEpisodeRemoved.description: A chronicle episode's card was removed. Written by: DELETE /api/nodes/{id}.

memoryConclusionRecorded.description: The memory returned a conclusion about someone to the wheel. Written by: POST /api/memory/conclusions.

memoryConclusionJudged.description: A person confirmed or rejected a conclusion. Written by: PATCH /api/memory/conclusions/{id}.

memoryConclusionAmended.description: A conclusion's node changed by another door than judging. Written by: PATCH /api/nodes/{id}.

memoryConclusionRemoved.description: A conclusion was removed. Written by: DELETE /api/nodes/{id}.

chronicleLineageMade.description: One chronicle episode was related to another — it continues from it, or relates to it — with the words that say why. Written by: POST /api/edges between two chronicle_episode nodes; the Miadi lineage door (POST /api/chronicle/episodes/{ref}/lineage) writes there.

chronicleLineageAmended.description: A relation between two chronicle episodes changed — most often, the words that say why were written. Written by: PATCH /api/edges between two chronicle_episode nodes; POST /api/edges over an existing pair.

chronicleLineageRemoved.description: A relation between two chronicle episodes was released. Written by: DELETE /api/edges between two chronicle_episode nodes.

nodeCreated.description: A relational node was created — a person, a place, a teaching, an agent. Written by: POST /api/nodes; MCP create_relational_node and the tools that make nodes.

nodeAmended.description: A relational node changed. Written by: PATCH /api/nodes/{id}; POST /api/nodes with a known id.

nodeRemoved.description: A relational node was removed. Written by: DELETE /api/nodes/{id}.

relationMade.description: A relation was woven between two nodes. Written by: POST /api/edges; MCP create_relational_edge.

relationAmended.description: A relation changed: its strength, its obligations, the ceremony that honoured it. Written by: PATCH /api/edges; POST /api/edges over an existing pair.

relationRemoved.description: A relation was released. Written by: DELETE /api/edges.

envelope.title: MiadiEventEnvelope (Medicine Wheel)
envelope.description: A Medicine Wheel event in jgwill/Miadi's MiadiEventEnvelope 0.1.0. The payload carries references and labels; a person's words travel only where privacy.content_included says so, and only words already published (an episode manifest's lineage sentence).

event_type.description: The namespaced event name; also its topic.

instance.description: The wheel that observed it, as configured (MW_INSTANCE).

id.description: The record the event is about; read it back from the wheel by this id.

actor.description: Who acted, when the record names them: a speaker, a participant, a source, a judge.

correlation_id.description: Groups related events: a cycle and the beats recorded in it, a ceremony and its closing.

causation_id.description: The event that directly led to this one.

idempotency_key.description: Equal to id. A resend is the same occurrence.
